prompt: Revise this original Heavy Strike card illustration to match a calm cool-toned middle-school game art series. Preserve the strong dark-navy rectangular calligraphy paperweight landing on one blank white practice sheet and one restrained coral impact arc; these are the only foreground objects. Remove the warm brown desk, sunny classroom view, distant town, and busy background. Replace them with a faint cool blue-gray school desk plane and generous pale blue-gray negative space. The whole bar, paper and arc must fit in central 52 percent width and 55 percent height and read at 113x57 hand-card art and 48px thumbnail. Use soft youthful anime storybook gouache with clean dark-navy contour and moderate brush texture; colors cool navy, teal and lavender with only the coral impact accent. This must differ from the separate Strike card with a pencil tearing paper: no pencil, no torn paper, no blade or person. No text, letters, logos, rarity, card frame, photorealism, grit or imitation of another game. Output 3:2 landscape.
